safety: Work one small step at a time.
Run npm.cmd run build after every meaningful CSS change.
Run npm.cmd run dev and visually preview after build.
Commit after every safe completed step.
Do not edit many CSS sections together.
Do not start Tailwind migration from homepage, header, or footer.
css_order: Keep @import order identical to original CSS order unless there is a very specific reason.
Keep overrides.css near the end because it intentionally wins the cascade.
next_generated_files: next-env.d.ts may change automatically after build/dev.
Do not commit next-env.d.ts if it only changed because of Next generated route types.
If .next generated types break, remove .next and rebuild.

next_recommended_step.phase: Migrate remaining route-specific CSS to Tailwind
reason: The homepage and global shell now use Tailwind utilities only.
Legacy CSS still exists for specific routes such as Find Your Room, rooms categories, quizzes, village/beach pages, trip planner, welcome, and staff.
Each route should be migrated and verified separately to avoid visual regressions.
process: Pick one route-specific stylesheet and its owning component.
Convert static styling to Tailwind utilities.
Keep only genuinely dynamic inline values such as runtime progress widths or image URLs.
Remove the route CSS import after confirming no selectors remain in use.
Run the production build and visually verify the affected route.
Update this state file and commit the isolated migration.

do_not_do_next: Do not delete all legacy route CSS in one unverified change.
Do not claim the entire repository is Tailwind-only until every route-specific import is removed.
Do not convert genuinely dynamic runtime values into unsafe generated Tailwind class names.
Do not commit next-env.d.ts if it changes automatically.

future_ui_direction.note: Use shadcn/ui carefully. Keep the warm premium Voulamandis House style and avoid making the site look like a generic template.

short_summary: The homepage and global shell now use Tailwind utilities only, with app/globals.css reduced to the required Tailwind import. The production build passed and the live desktop hero was verified without the previous black gap. Route-specific legacy CSS still remains and must be migrated one route at a time.
